def export_csv(rows):
    """Rows of (name, amount) -> CSV text with a header line.

    BUG-107 fix: a name containing a comma is double-quoted so the row keeps two
    columns (pre-fix shape: out.append("{},{}".format(name, amount)) emitted the
    name raw, so ("a,b", 10) produced the three-column row a,b,10).
    """
    out = ["name,amount"]
    for name, amount in rows:
        if "," in name:
            name = '"{}"'.format(name)
        out.append("{},{}".format(name, amount))
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"

class TestBug107CommaGuard(unittest.TestCase):
    """Regression guard for BUG-107: export_csv([("a,b", 10)]) emitted the three-column
    row a,b,10 because the pre-fix body interpolated the name raw:
        out.append("{},{}".format(name, amount))
    The fix (report.py) double-quotes a name containing a comma."""

    def test_comma_name_stays_two_columns(self):
        text = export_csv([("a,b", 10)])
        row = text.splitlines()[1]
        self.assertEqual(row, '"a,b",10')


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
